system.description:
• Effect: Pay for Metamagic (see Metamagic Options) by burning Constitution points.
  • Burned Constitution uses its lower modifier for everything except your HP and your death threshold.
  • Spellburn carries no Corruption risk.
  • The cost doubles with each Spellburn you make in a day, as the table below shows.
  • Unlike Wild Surge it has no daily limit, only what your body can afford.
  • Spellburn cannot reduce your Constitution below 1.
  • Recovery: after a long rest you regain 3 burned Constitution points, and by no other means.
  • 6th level (Blood Burn): you regain 6 burned points after a long rest.

activities.name: Spellburn
activities.text: Pay for Metamagic by burning Constitution: 1 point for your first burn each day, then 2, 4, 8 (the enhanced effect costs double); never below 1. After a long rest you regain {1:3, 6:6} burned Constitution points, and by no other means.
